entry.author: Inland Revenue NZ
entry.summary:
The Momo Whakahaere kauhau (presentations) are an introduction to taxes for whānau Māori trusts. Part 1 provides general information on the tax treatment for whānau Māori trusts. 

More information:
Learn more about how we can help you and your whānau:
https://www.ird.govt.nz/maori

Ask for guidance from your local Kaitakawaenga Māori:
https://www.ird.govt.nz/contactus/kaitakawaenga-maori

Watch Momo Whakahaere – Part 2:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aoJKYFn9YHY
